info.title: shelfdrop
info.description: The API of shelfdrop for a program: the work search, the releases of Prowlarr, the downloads, Ranger, the waiting searches. Every request sends an access token created on the page Paramètres, Accès: `Authorization: Bearer sd_...`. Each operation names the scope it needs in `x-access`: `read` (any token) or `write` (a token `write`). Every error body is `{"code", "detail", "data"}`; the codes are listed in the schema `ErrorCode`.

token.description: An access token (`sd_...`) created on the page Paramètres, Accès. `read` reads; `write` also downloads, places files and keeps searches waiting. 60 requests a minute; never the settings nor the tokens. No `Origin` needed.
